=== CONCEPT ===
-O OS detection combined with -Pn (skip host discovery, treat as alive) and -n (no DNS resolution) for scanning targets that don't respond to ping. Used when firewall blocks ICMP but TCP ports are open.

=== HOW OS DETECTION WORKS ===
Nmap sends a series of TCP/UDP/ICMP probes and analyzes responses against its OS fingerprint database. TTL values, TCP window sizes, and IP/TCP option sequences identify the OS family and version.

=== FIREWALL CONTEXT ===
Firewalls often block ICMP entirely — host appears 'down' to normal host discovery. -Pn skips discovery and assumes host is alive, proceeding directly to port scanning. Essential for scanning through firewalls.
